title: Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin - Crucifix Held Close
description:
This is Crucifix Held Close from Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin, which is actually a remix of another Castlevania song, Cross Your Heart from Haunted Castle.

Use this if you want a epic feel to your Castle level; like most Castlevania songs, they definitely deliver when it comes to castle levels of any kind lol
